name: scdaw_write_notes
description: Write or merge notes into a track. Supports step indices (0-15 per bar), musical beat units, or raw PPQN pulses. Pitch can be MIDI number, note name ('C4'), or drum name ('kick', 'snare', 'hat', 'clap').

units.description: Timebase units used in notes array: 'bars' (1-indexed bar & beat), 'steps' (0-15 per bar), 'beats', or 'ppqn'

mode.description: 'replace' overwrites all notes in track, 'merge' appends to existing notes

pitch.description: Note pitch (MIDI number 0-127, note string 'C4', or drum name 'kick')

notes.description: List of notes to write (e.g. [{ bar: 1, beat: 1, note: 'E3', dur: '1/8', vel: 0.8 }])
